name: Office block (setback top) (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Six-storey office block, 30 x 20 m: five floors of grey brick with ribbon windows and dark bands, topped by a fully glazed sixth floor set back 4 m at each end behind roof terraces with glass balustrades, paving and planters. Lobby and offices below, office floors with glass-walled meeting rooms, a boardroom and lounge on the top floor opening onto both terraces; a core of stairs, lift and toilets, the stair rising to a roof door; rooftop units and a water tank.
